movie.title: The Invisible Guest
movie.overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A successful businessman accused of murdering his lover works with a relentless defense attorney to uncover the truth during a high-stakes three-hour interrogation.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After waking up in a locked hotel room next to the body of his lover, Adrián Doria hires prestigious witness preparation expert Virginia Goodman to build his defense. With a surprise prosecution witness set to testify in three hours, they must dissect the timeline of events leading up to the murder. As Goodman pushes for absolute honesty, Adrián recounts a web of blackmail, car crashes, and cover-ups that complicate his narrative. However, as discrepancies emerge, the line between victim and perpetrator blurs completely.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Entrepreneur Adrián Doria finds himself under home arrest for the murder of his mistress, Laura Vidal, after being found in a locked hotel room with her corpse and a briefcase of money. Facing imminent trial, his legal team hires veteran prep attorney Virginia Goodman for a final, intense three-hour meeting before a surprise state witness testifies. Adrián initially claims they were lured to the remote hotel by an anonymous blackmailer who killed Laura and knocked him unconscious. Goodman remains skeptical, pointing out logical flaws in his story and forcing him to confess to a prior hit-and-run accident that destroyed a young man's life. According to Adrián, Laura forced him to hide the victim's body in a trunk and sink the vehicle in a lake to protect their secrets. As Goodman presents alternative theories of the crime, including the possibility that the victim's grieving parents framed him, the interrogation grows increasingly hostile. Goodman continuously pushes Adrián to reveal deeper secrets, exposing his cold-hearted opportunism and refusal to take responsibility. Ultimately, a final twist reveals that Goodman's identity is not what it seems, completely dismantling Adrián's defense in the closing moments.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Invisible Guest is a suspenseful spanish mystery thriller centered around Adrián Doria, a wealthy entrepreneur whose ideal life unravels when he is trapped in a locked hotel room with the dead body of his lover. With only a few hours to prepare before a critical court deadline, he must work alongside a famed legal consultant to piece together a coherent defense. Through a series of shifting testimonies, intense questioning, and intricate flashbacks, the story unravels a complex web of deception, guilt, and vengeance where nothing is as it appears.

story_structure.climax: As the deadline approaches, Virginia pushes Adrián to reveal the final, unvarnished truth regarding the night of the accident and the mysterious orchestrator behind the hotel room trap.
story_structure.conflict: Facing an imminent murder charge, Adrián hires elite defense attorney Virginia Goodman, who insists on complete transparency during a high-stakes, three-hour interview to prepare their legal defense.
story_structure.resolution: A shocking revelation exposes the true identities and motives of those involved, reframing the entire timeline and bringing justice to light.
story_structure.introduction: Successful entrepreneur Adrián Doria wakes up in a locked hotel room next to the corpse of his lover, Laura, with no apparent way out for anyone else.
story_structure.risingAction: Through a series of intense interrogations and shifting flashbacks, the narrative unravels a dark secret involving a previous fatal car accident, a missing young man, and a desperate cover-up.
